limitations: All 108 unique venue coordinates are verified: 21 from official-linked published map locations and 87 from matched OpenStreetMap physical-venue polygon interior points, cross-checked against official venue identity. OSM-derived coordinates retain their object source, matching evidence, attribution and ODbL-1.0 license.
Regular home-ground assignments are a checked-at snapshot, not exhaustive match-by-match temporary ground history.
Null validFrom/validTo means dates not verified, not perpetual tenure.
Venue IDs are stable physical-place IDs; sponsorship renames must update aliases rather than create new places.
No personal visit, tour or match-attendance states are inferred.

Rayo temporary use of Butarque is confirmed for the 2026-09-15 league match only. Full temporary tenure start/end dates and permanent league-return date remain unverified; the 2026-10-03 friendly announcement alone is insufficient.
Competition country is not venue geography: AS Monaco belongs to Ligue 1 while Stade Louis-II is in Monaco.
Some official home-ground evidence is a published future season fixture, not a completed match; verify again before attending or freezing date-specific venue history.
